messages.subject: new error appearing using matR
parts:
Hi,

I have been using matR for several months to successfully extract annotations from MG-RAST for my private metagenomes

In the last few days I have been getting the following error

Warning in file(con, "r") :
  cannot open: HTTP status was '401 Authorization Required'
Error in fromJSON(x, asText = TRUE, simplify = TRUE) : 
  error in evaluating the argument 'content' in selecting a method for function 'fromJSON': Error in file(con, "r") : cannot open the connection

Any Suggestions?

Kind Regards

Thomas

messages.author: 4ad48a1892b8a420
messages.subject: Re: new error appearing using matR
parts:
That message usually means you are trying to access private data without a valid token.

Make sure that your account has access to the metagenomes, and follow the posting for
accessing private data if you have not done so before.

Note that tokens expire after a number of months.

Cheers
Kevin
